subject: BrightPath: Scheduling on-prem / VPC architecture review - availability poll
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightpathhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: BrightPath: Scheduling on-prem / VPC architecture review - availability poll

Hi Sarah,

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery: BrightPath is evaluating a private hosting option for the inference workload, with priority on strict network isolation, certificate rotation, and integration with your on-prem identity provider. The next best step is a focused architecture review with your infra/security engineers and our infra team so we can walk the proposed topology, prerequisites, and rollout options.

Proposed goals for the call:
- Align on VPC vs on-prem deployment constraints and preferred control plane model
- Review network boundaries, routing, and egress controls
- Surface any compliance prerequisites (cert rotation, KMS/HSM touchpoints, audit log retention)
- Agree on a follow-up plan and owners

Can you confirm who from BrightPath should attend? You mentioned a security lead earlier; happy to include them. To make scheduling easier, here are 30/60 minute options next week (all in PST):
- Tue 2028-06-13 09:00 - 09:30
- Wed 2028-06-14 10:00 - 11:00
- Thu 2028-06-15 08:30 - 09:00

If none of these work, please propose two times and we will adapt. If you prefer, I can send a Doodle/availability poll.

Prep for the call:
- I will circulate a short agenda and an internal checklist we use for private deployments (attached).
- If you can share a high-level network diagram or any IP allowlists before the call, that will save time.

Attendees from our side will be me (account lead), Rishi Malhotra (infrastructure engineer), and Connor Obrien (solutions PM, CC'd as needed).

Thanks,

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai
Attachment: prelim-security-checklist.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-10T18:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath: Scheduling on-prem / VPC architecture review - availability poll

Thanks Hannah, and thanks for the summary.

Wed 2028-06-14 10:00 - 11:00 PST works for us, that would be ideal. I will loop in Mike Torres (our security engineer) - he is CC'd here.

A few items to prioritize on the call:
- How certificate rotation and KMS integration will work if we host on-prem
- Network egress patterns and whether sandboxed inference traffic can be kept within our VPC
- Any port whitelisting or firewall changes you will need from our side

I attached a rough network sketch and our internal firewall rule summary for context.

See you then,

Sarah Nguyen
Senior Product Manager, BrightPath Health
sarah.nguyen@brightpathhealth.com
Attachment: brightpath-network-draft.png (png, 85KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightpathhealth.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor.obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-06-10T20:10:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath: Scheduling on-prem / VPC architecture review - availability poll

Thanks Sarah, confirmed for Wed 2028-06-14 10:00 - 11:00 PST. Adding a short proposed agenda and attendees so everyone is aligned.

Proposed agenda (45-60 min):
- 10:00 - 10:10 Introductions and scope (Hannah / Sarah)
- 10:10 - 10:30 Network and connectivity review (BrightPath lead + Rishi)
- 10:30 - 10:45 Security integrations: KMS, cert rotation, audit logs (Mike + Rishi)
- 10:45 - 11:00 Rollout options and next steps (Connor / Hannah)

Expected Redwood attendees: Rishi Malhotra (Infrastructure), Connor Obrien (Solutions PM), Hannah Schmitt (Account).

Pre-call ask from our side: if you can drop the network diagram and any CIDR/allowlist information into the Drive folder below, Rishi will do a quick pass and call out anything that would block a straight VPC-hosted approach. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbcdExample

I attached a short agenda doc and a private-hosting checklist so we can run through prerequisites quickly.

Thanks,

Rishi Malhotra
Senior Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Attachment: redwood-priv-arch-agenda.pdf (pdf, 220KB)

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@brightpathhealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: Mike Torres <mike.torres@brightpathhealth.com>
Date: 2028-06-11T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Re: BrightPath: Scheduling on-prem / VPC architecture review - availability poll

Sounds good, the Drive folder now has the network sketch, allowlist table, and a short note from our infra team. We booked Wed 2028-06-14 10:00 - 11:00 PST in our calendars and created a Zoom invite: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=example123

Two quick asks before the call:
1) Can you send any SOC 2 or compliance doc references you typically share for private deployments so Mike can review ahead of time?
2) We may need an initial list of ports and IPs you will contact for the deployment so our firewall team can pre-approve them. A short CSV would be ideal.

Appreciate the responsiveness, looking forward to the session.

Best,

Sarah

Attachment: none
